data.name: Doost
data.gender_notes: Doost is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is loyal and trustworthy, a companion, a friend. The name Doost carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Doost usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guardian angel, a spiritual guide, a protector
data.etymology: Doost belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Doost total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: دوست
in_arabic.long_meaning: دوست صيغته من الصيغ الثلاثية المكونة من ثلاث حروف. الدال، الواو، السين. معناه المودود أو المُحِبّ. ويمكن أن يكون هذا الاسم منسوباً إلى شخص يعرف بالمودة أو المحبة، أو من خلال إلقاء الضوء على شخصية الشخص المسمى به هذا الاسم. يعتبر الاسم شائعاً في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالمعاني النبيلة للعلاقة الإنسانية. يعتبر دوست أيضاً اسماءً للناس في القرآن الكريم، حيث يُذكر في سورة القصص آية (صادقاً بِدوستِهِ).

in_urdu.name: دوست
in_urdu.long_meaning: دوست کا نام اردو میں ایک عربی نام ہے، جو صیغہ ثلاثی کا حصہ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مودود یا محب، جو کسی شخص کے اپنے اور دوسرے کے درمیان پیار اور محبت کا نام ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں ایک اہم نام ہے اور اس کی وجہ یہ ہے کہ اس میں پیار اور محبت کی عکاسی ہے۔ یہ نام قریبی اور اچھی طرح کی تعلقات کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दोस्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: दोस्त नाम हिंदी में एक अरबी नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है मित्र या प्रिय। यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है और इसका महत्व इसे दिए गए अर्थ और इसके उपयोग के कारण है। दोस्त नाम का अर्थ है प्रेम और सहानुभूति का प्रकट करना, जो मुस्लिम परंपराओं में एक महत्वपूर्ण भावना मानी जाती है।

in_english.name: Doost
in_english.meaning: Means friend or loved one, symbolizing affection and closeness
in_english.long_meaning: The Arabic name Doost is derived from the root د-و-س (d-w-s), which means to love or be loved. In Islamic tradition, the name Doost is associated with the concept of friendship and affection, highlighting the importance of relationships and social connections. The name Doost is also mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the value of loyal friends and companions. In many Muslim cultures, the name Doost is given to children born into loving families or with affectionate personalities, signifying the parents' hope for their child to be a source of love and comfort to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Doost" holds significant cultural importance in various Muslim communities. In Persian language and culture, "Doost" is a title given to an individual who is trusted, dependable, and loyal. In Pakistan, this name is often given to boys as a display of trust, and in Iran, it is used interchangeably with "Agha" or "Akhund," signifying respect and admiration.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Doost" holds a deeper meaning as it relates to the Quranic concept of 'Sakina' or tranquility, peace, and security. In many ways, a person named Doost is expected to embody this virtue and bring peace and comfort to those around them. The name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of being a friend and companion, especially in times of need. A Doost is a person of integrity, empathy, and kindness, whose presence brings solace and serves as a beacon of hope. It is a name that inspires one to strive for a virtuous and god-conscious life.
